pairs.registryProposal: The technique marks its no-default rule for fakes as inference. These fakes reset to ok and each failing path is set explicitly, so the measured harm here is narrower: an outcome the fake has no knob for. The rule could be sharpened to require that every outcome the real driver can report is reachable through the fake.
